title: Bitcoin self-custody solutions see record downloads amid ban
content: TL;DR: A global surge in self-custody solution downloads signals a profound shift away from perceived banking instability towards Bitcoin's unconfiscatable nature. As the Bitcoin network operates with an unyielding hashrate of 902.96 EH/s, transactors are increasingly embracing true monetary sovereignty by holding their own keys. This movement underscores Bitcoin's foundational promise as a trustless, censorship-resistant alternative to an increasingly fragile traditional financial system.
author: Al Ingle
